hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom 1:1 ETH/phiEth swap curve using beforeSwapReturnsDelta, bypassing AMM price math entirely. It takes the input from the PoolManager, converts via the phiEth contract (deposit or withdraw), and settles the output — all within beforeSwap. Direct liquidity additions are permanently blocked.
